# The board grammar, as a fixture both sides are run over.
#
# `keel/boards.py` decides what may be written and `app/ui.board.js` parses the same lines
# to render them, so the two have to agree about what a line MEANS or the deck draws
# something the record does not say. tests/test_boards.py runs Python over every row here
# and, when node is on the machine, the deck's parser over the same rows.
#
# One row per line: the verdict, a tab, then the line exactly as an agent would send it.
# OK   the line parses (what it then DOES is judged against the board it lands on, which
#       is the server's half alone and is tested in tests/test_boards.py, not here)
# BAD  the line does not parse, so it is skipped with a reason
#
# This file is the grammar's only fixture. A new op goes in here first.

OK	board "How Keel is laid out"
OK	board new "The second picture"
OK	board rename "What it should have been called"
OK	group box "The box (Oracle VPS)"
OK	node phone phone "His phone"
OK	node mac laptop "The Mac" in home
OK	node mac laptop "The Mac" in home "work houses"
OK	node deck server "keel serve" "the deck and the board"
OK	node odd wombat "an unknown icon falls back to box"
OK	edge phone -> voice
OK	edge phone -> voice "speech, tailnet"
OK	edge deck <-> mac "the door, 22 ms"
OK	edge a -- b "just connected"
OK	mark mac accent
OK	mark mac crit
OK	note board "The agent says **what** exists. The board decides `where` it goes."
OK	note deck "one note, hanging on a node"
OK	step board "You stop talking, the detector waits 2.5 s"
OK	step deck "the step that belongs to this node"
OK	table board "Where the time goes"
OK	table deck "what this one costs"
OK	cols Part | Today | After
OK	row Process start | 3.6 s | hidden at connect
OK	code deck "keel/converse.py"
OK	lang python
OK	line "def take_turn(cfg, board, card, said):"
OK	path board "state/cards/c-420/probe.py" size "2 KB" from house
OK	path deck "probe.py" size "2 KB" from talker
OK	  node spaced laptop "leading space is fine"
OK	# a comment is not an op and is not an error
OK	```
OK	```board
OK
